text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And so I told the secretary, "Time's up,<n>show me
the minutes."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ohh, that's a good one! An impressivejoke, coming from the prez!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aha, a rival steps into the ring.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Well, jokes—or more like puns—are<n>kinda my
thing too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Where I'm from, instead of "hello," the<n>
neighborhood uncles greet you with a<n>pun. You
develop a taste for it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the puns you teach me are the<n>cream of
the comedic crop, veritable<n>gems. Mine don't
even begin to<n>compare.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's all a matter of experience. I tell ya,<n>thirty or
forty percent of what comes out<n>of their mouths is
puns.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
They'll be out in the fields like, "Blue<n>jeans? Nah,
I'm aubergines!" or "I'm<n>rootin' for ya!" and "Weed
love to!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh, interesting. Hey Rudolf, why don't<n>you take
inspiration from what you<n>know? Like,
race-related things!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hm... It pays off to keep pace with one's competition. I was taking a cold drinkbefore the race, but when I saw who myopponents were, I gulped.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm starting to get the hang of<n>this... Right,
I'll keep looking for<n>inspiration in the things
around me.<n>Perhaps one day, I'll match you in<n>
experience.
